text:
zoe: Quick UX bug: when the chart switches to 'percent' units the axis shows "%" after the number (e.g., 50%) but our tick-abbrev logic turns 1,200% into 1.2k% which looks odd. Proposing we move unit suffix into a separate compact unit pill for percentages and durations to avoid confusing combos (eg. `1.2k%` -> `1.2k` + pill `%`). Thoughts?

pavel: Agree, separating unit suffix helps parsing. Also we need to keep sign placement obvious for negatives: show `-1.2k` not `1.2k-`.

rina: Accessibility: SRs expect the full phrase, so pill should have `aria-label` like "Percent (percentage)" and axis container gets `aria-valuetext` for each tick so screen readers read "one thousand two hundred percent". Don't rely on visual-only pill.

tom: Visual treatment idea: when unit pill is present, ticks use plain numbers (abbrev allowed) and the pill shows full unit and aggregation window (eg. "% (30s avg)"). On hover/focus the pill expands to a short explainer.

emi: Outlier handling: proposal for a hybrid: soft-dim for points beyond 3x IQR, plus an inline caret marker on the axis pointing to the true max when it would otherwise squash the scale. Caret should be subtle and keyboard-focusable.

zoe: Smoothing: keep smoothing visual-only and ensure `aria-pressed` on the toggle. Also important: when smoothing is ON, the raw datapoint tooltip must still show raw values, not smoothed values.

pavel: Small CSS snippet for pill mobility and negative sign rule:

```css
.unit-pill{position:absolute;right:12px;top:8px;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)}
.tick-number{white-space:nowrap}
/* ensure minus is next to number */
.tick-number::before{content:attr(data-sign)}
```

rina: UX microcopy: try label variations: (A) "Unit: % (30s avg)" (B) "Percent — shows proportion of total". Prefer A for brevity.

tom: Test plan: 8 users (4 infra engineers, 2 product, 2 accessibility) with 3 variants: 1) suffix-in-tick (current), 2) unit-pill + plain ticks, 3) unit-pill + caret-for-max. Tasks: read largest spike, read unit, and use keyboard-only to find unit. Measure accuracy + time and SR feedback.

emi: Perf note: caret markers are cheap if we render as a single overlay layer; avoid per-point DOM nodes. Dimming is cheapest.

accessibility-bot: A11y checklist: 1) axis container `aria-label` includes full unit, 2) pill has `role=button` + `aria-expanded` for the explainer, 3) ticks provide `aria-valuetext`, 4) smoothing toggle announces state (aria-pressed), 5) ARIA live optionally announces de-emphasized spikes.

zoe: Decision: prototype variant 2 (unit-pill + plain/abbrev ticks) and a small explorative for caret-only on mobile. Kai (design) to make mocks; rina to draft aria patterns; pavel to validate negative sign handling in rendering lib. Meet Fri to review. :thumbsup:
